verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Greenhouse has candidate stages: partners can retrieve a candidate's stage, and the API can advance, move and reject applications. That API is a developer building block, not a recruiter-facing configurable pipeline. Nothing in the pack documents custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, or bulk actions across a pipeline. The "bulk outreach campaigns" item covers sourcing outreach, an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline
